title: Mouse in a little scarf

<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M43 51 L26 47' stroke='#f4ecff' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
